name: Policy and standards review plan
description: Every policy and standard due for review in the period goes through owner review, consultation and approval, one test record per document. The population is proposed from the policy library: the documents whose next review date falls in the period, and any already overdue.

plan.title: {year} Policy and Standards Review Plan
plan.objective: By {period_end_long}, every ICT and information security policy and standard due for review in {year} has been reviewed by its owner, consulted on and approved by the body its approval route names, so that the documented framework the ICT risk management rests on is current.
plan.decisions_requested:
Approve the {year} review schedule: the documents in scope and the quarter each is reviewed in.
Confirm the approval route for each document type: the management body for policies, the ICT Risk Committee for standards and procedures.
Mandate document owners to complete their review by the wave deadline.
raci_roles: Consulted functions (Legal, Compliance, HR, Operational Risk)

steps.title: Confirm the mandate and the approval route for each document type
Propose the population from the policy library and confirm it with the owners
steps.deliverable: Review schedule: one row per document, in the quarter it is due

steps.title: Confirm each document's owner, consultees and approver
Review plan approved by the ICT Risk Committee
Freeze the schedule
steps.deliverable: Frozen population in the plan record

steps.title: Owner review of the wave's documents
steps.deliverable: Redline, or a no-change statement, for each document

steps.title: Open the review record for each document of the wave
Consultation with the affected functions
steps.deliverable: Consultation log with the disposition of every comment

steps.title: Approval by the authorised body; next review date set
steps.deliverable: Approval minute or record; new version in the policy library

steps.title: 2LoD check and QA sign-off of each review record
steps.deliverable: QA sign-off on every review record

steps.title: Quarterly review status to the ICT Risk Committee
Draft the {next_year} review schedule
steps.deliverable: Draft {next_year} schedule from the policy library

steps.title: Annual policy framework statement to the management body
steps.deliverable: Statement that the framework is reviewed and current, with exceptions

steps.title: Input to the annual ICT RMF review report
steps.deliverable: Section for the ICT risk management framework review report

steps.title: Event-driven reviews on major change, new regulation or a significant incident
steps.deliverable: Review record for each event-driven review

strata.name: Policies
strata.definition: Policies, approved by the management body

strata.name: Standards and procedures
strata.definition: Standards, procedures, work instructions, guidelines and targeted risk analyses, approved by the ICT Risk Committee or the owner's function

attributes.requirement: The owner has reviewed the document for its continued suitability, adequacy and effectiveness, against what changed since the last review: regulation, threats, technology and the organisation.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the owner's review record and the redline or the no-change statement.
attributes.evidence_requested: Review record; redline or no-change statement
attributes.pass_criteria: A dated review by the owner says what was considered and what changed, or why nothing did.

attributes.requirement: The functions the document affects were consulted and their comments resolved.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the consultation log: who was consulted, their comments and the disposition of each.
attributes.pass_criteria: Consulted functions are recorded, and every comment is accepted, rejected with a reason or deferred to the next review.

attributes.requirement: The document is approved by the body its approval route names, and its next review date is set.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the approval minute or record and the document's version history in the policy library.
attributes.pass_criteria: Approved by the authorised body, with a new version, an effective date and a next review date.

attributes.requirement: The approved document is published and communicated to those it applies to.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the publication in the policy library and the communication record.
attributes.pass_criteria: Published and communicated within 10 business days of approval.

raci.activity: Approve the review schedule and the approval routes
Propose and maintain the schedule from the policy library
Check and QA the review record
Report the status and the annual statement

cadence.content: Documents in review, consultation status, approvals due
Reviews completed and approved, overdue documents, standards for approval

cadence.frequency: Annually, and for each policy approval
cadence.content: Policies for approval; the annual statement on the framework

escalations.trigger: Owner review not done by the wave deadline
escalations.escalate_to: Owner's line manager, then the CISO

escalations.trigger: A document past its next review date
A consultation comment the owner and the consultee cannot resolve

regulatory_basis.requirement: The management body puts in place policies that aim to ensure the maintenance of high standards of availability, authenticity, integrity and confidentiality of data.
regulatory_basis.how: Policies are approved by the management body in the quarter they are due (attribute PR-03).

regulatory_basis.requirement: Develop and document an information security policy as part of the ICT risk management framework.
regulatory_basis.how: The information security policy and the standards under it are in the population and reviewed when due.

regulatory_basis.requirement: Review the ICT risk management framework, of which the policies are part, at least once a year.
regulatory_basis.how: The annual statement and the input to the framework review report say which documents were reviewed and which are overdue.

regulatory_basis.requirement: Review the information security policies at planned intervals and if significant changes occur.
regulatory_basis.how: The schedule follows each document's review date, and event-driven reviews run alongside it (step O.1).
